title: Homemade Health Mix Powder ( Sathu Maavu Mix ) Recipe for Babies
title_hi: घर का बना स्वास्थ्य मिश्रण पाउडर (सत्तू मावू मिक्स) बच्चों के लिए पकाने की विधि
content:
This is a super-duper healthy mix for your baby. You could buy a decent health powder mix from shops. But I love to make it myself for my baby because you get to know what goes into them and you can customize it as per your baby needs. 

I added rice and pulses in my health mix. So I feed this porridge for my baby for lunch instead of giving rice khichdi. I made two versions of this powder, one savory and one sweet. 

 

For making porridge out of it:

 

you can mix a couple of tablespoons of this powder with some water and cook it for 10 mins on a very low flame till the rice and dal are cooked. Then you can add some sweetener to sweet one and salt in the savory one. It is that simple.

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Cooking Time: 1 hour

 

Ingredients:

 

Rice – 1.5 cup ( I used cooking rice, ponni brand)

Barley – 1 cup

Roasted Gram Dal / Pori Kadalai / Pottu Kadalai – 1 cup

Whole Black Urad Dal – 1 cup

Green Gram Dal – 1 cup

Yellow Moong Dal / Pasi Paruppu – 1/2 cup

Masoor Dal – 1/2 cup

Broken Wheat / Cracked Wheat / Dalia – 1 cup

Cashew – 1/2 cup

Badam / Almond – 1/2 cup

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam – 1 teaspoon

Ajwain Seeds / Omam – 1/2 teaspoon

Cardamom / Yelakai – 10 pods (If using this, leave ajwain and cumin)

 

 

Method:

 

Take urad dal and green gram in a bowl and wash them well, drain and add to a dry pan and roast till it turns golden brown and dry. Remove to a plate.

Take masoor dal and yellow moong dal in a bowl and wash them well, drain and add to a

dry pan and roast till it turns golden brown and dry. Remove to the same plate.

Take rice and barley in a bowl and wash them well, drain and add to a

dry pan and roast till it turns golden brown and dry. Remove to the same

plate.

Roast roasted gram dal till golden and remove to the same plate.

Roast Dalia till golden and remove to the same plate.

Roast cashews and almonds till golden and remove to the same plate.

Roast cumin and ajwain till golden and remove to the same plate. If you are making a sweet one, leave ajwain and cumin and add cardamom to it.

I made two versions, so I took half of the mix and added cardamom to one and roasted cumin and ajwain in another. Now grind them in a mixer and sieve it.

Store in an airtight container.
content_hi:
यह आपके बच्चे के लिए एक सुपर-डुपर हेल्दी मिक्स है। आप दुकानों से एक अच्छा स्वास्थ्य पाउडर मिश्रण खरीद सकते हैं। लेकिन मैं इसे अपने बच्चे के लिए खुद बनाना पसंद करती हूं क्योंकि आपको पता है कि उनमें क्या जाता है और आप इसे अपने बच्चे की जरूरतों के अनुसार अनुकूलित कर सकते हैं।

मैंने अपने स्वास्थ्य मिश्रण में चावल और दालें मिलाईं। इसलिए मैं चावल की खिचड़ी देने के बजाय अपने बच्चे को दोपहर के भोजन के लिए यह दलिया खिलाती हूं। मैंने इस पाउडर के दो संस्करण बनाए, एक दिलकश और एक मीठा।

 

इसके लिए दलिया बनाने के लिए:

 

आप इस पाउडर के एक चम्मच को थोड़े से पानी के साथ मिला सकते हैं और इसे 10 मिनट तक धीमी आंच पर चावल और दाल के पकने तक पका सकते हैं। फिर आप मिठाई में कुछ मीठा करने के लिए और नमकीन में नमक डाल सकते हैं। यह इतना आसान है।

 

तैयारी का समय: 10 मिनट

खाना पकाने का समय: 1 घंटा

 

सामग्री:

 

चावल - 1.5 कप (मैं चावल, पोनी ब्रांड का खाना बनाती थी)

जौ - 1 कप

भुना हुआ ग्राम दाल / पोरी कदलाई / कुट्टू कदलाई - 1 कप

साबुत काली उड़द दाल - 1 कप

ग्रीन ग्राम दाल - 1 कप

पीला मूंग दाल / पासी परप्पू - 1/2 कप

मसूर दाल - 1/2 कप

टूटे हुए गेहूं / फटा गेहूं / दलिया - 1 कप

काजू - 1/2 कप

बादाम / बादाम - 1/2 कप

जीरा बीज / जीरकम - 1 चम्मच

अजवाईन बीज / ओमम - १/२ चम्मच

इलायची / येलाकाई - 10 फली (यदि इसका उपयोग करते हैं, तो अजवाईन और जीरा छोड़ दें)

 

 

तरीका:

 

एक कटोरे में उड़द दाल और हरे चने लें और उन्हें अच्छे से धो लें, सूखा पैन डालें और सुनहरा भूरा और सूखा होने तक भूनें। एक प्लेट में निकालें।

एक बाउल में मसूर दाल और पीली मूंग दाल लें और उन्हें अच्छे से धोएं, ड्रेन करें और उसमें डालें

सूखी कड़ाही और इसे सुनहरा भूरा और सूखा होने तक भूनें। एक ही प्लेट में निकालें।

एक कटोरे में चावल और जौ लें और उन्हें अच्छी तरह से धो लें, नाली में डालें और डालें

सूखी कड़ाही और इसे सुनहरा भूरा और सूखा होने तक भूनें। उसी को हटाओ

प्लेट।

भुने हुए चने की दाल को सुनहरा होने तक भूनें और उसी प्लेट में निकालें।

दलिया को सुनहरा होने तक तलें और उसी प्लेट में निकाल लें।

काजू और बादाम को सुनहरा होने तक भूनें और एक ही प्लेट में निकालें।

जीरा और अजवाईन को सुनहरा होने तक भूनें और एक ही प्लेट में निकालें। यदि आप एक मिठाई बना रहे हैं, तो अज्वैन और जीरा छोड़ दें और इसमें इलायची जोड़ें।

मैंने दो संस्करण बनाए, इसलिए मैंने मिश्रण का आधा हिस्सा लिया और एक में इलायची और दूसरे में भुना जीरा और अजवाइन मिलाया। अब इन्हें मिक्सी में पीस लें और छलनी से छान लें।

एक हवाबंद कंटेनर में भंडारित करें।

related.title: Tasty Oven Roasted Chicken ( With Vegetables ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी ओवेन रोस्टेड चिकन (सब्जियों के साथ) रेसिपी
related.content:
Delicious and very easy roast chicken with veggies tastes so yummy. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Healthy chicken with veggies.

This is an easy dinner or lunch to put together. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Once you assembled everything it takes around 40 to 45 mins to cook. The chicken is so flavourful and tastes so juicy. The chicken outside has a nice crust in them and the inside is so juicy.

 

Roast Chicken with Vegetables

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 5 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 whole chicken, cut into 12 pieces

Oil - 3 tablespoons

Carrot - 2 chopped

Cauliflower - 2 cups

Onion - 1 chopped

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Garlic - 10 cloves with skins on

 

FOR SPICE MIX:

Red Chilli Flakes - 1 tablespoon

Chilli Powder or Paprika - 1 tablespoon

Salt - 1 tablespoon

Parsley - 2 tablespoons

Oregano - 1 tablespoon

Sumac - 2 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Preheat oven to 200 degrees C. Mix spice mix together and set aside.

Take veggies in a baking pan. Add spice mix and oil and toss well.

Place chicken over it and sprinkle with spice mix and oil and mix well.

Pop it in the oven and bake for 35 to 45 mins.

Remove and serve it.

related.title: Tasty Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe
related.content:
Delicious spicy chicken curry made using roasted spice masala and coconut masala which is so yummy with rice.

This chicken curry is made using roasted whole spices masala which tastes super delicious. The freshly roasted spices give so much flavor to the chicken curry and make it super yummy.

 

Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 15 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 1 hour

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 serving

 

Ingredients

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Fennel seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 2 teaspoons

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam - 1 teaspoon

Bay Leaf - 1

Cardamom / Yelakai - 5

Cloves / Krambu - 5

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Brinji Ilai / Pandan Leaf - 1

Chicken - 1 kg

Shallots - 30 peeled and chopped finely

Tomato - 4 to 5 chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Salt to taste

Tomato - 1 chopped for adding last

Curry Leaves a handful for adding last

 

TO ROAST & GRIND:

Dry Red Chilli - 10 to 12

Coriander Leaves - 4 tablespoons

Cumin Seeds - 2 teaspoons

Black Pepper - 2 teaspoons

Curry leaves a handful

TO GRIND:

Coconut - 1 cup grated

Roasted Gram Dal / Pori Kadalai - 1 teaspoon

Fennel Seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Heat a pan, add whole spices to toast. Cook till golden. Take it in a blender and puree till smooth. Set aside.

Take coconut, gram dal, fennel and grind to a smooth paste.

Now heat oil in a pan, add in whole spices, onions and cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and saute till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and curry leaves and mix well.

Add in chicken and cook till 5 to 6 mins.

Add in roasted coconut masala and water. Mix well.

Add this in a pressure cooker and cook for 2 whistles.

Take it off the heat and open the cooker.

Add in potatoes and cook till it is done.

Add in coconut masala and simmer for 10 to 15 mins.

Take the curry off the heat and add in tomato and curry leaves.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Pepper Chicken ( Milagu )  Gravy Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी काली मिर्च चिकन (मिलगु) ग्रेवी रेसिपी
related.content:
Spicy black pepper chicken gravy goes well with roti, rice or idli or dosa too. This spicy chicken curry tastes super delicious and very peppery.

I have shared a few varieties of pepper chicken and mutton recipes here. But I haven’t shared the pepper chicken gravy which we simply love. I make this all the time. So here it is. It is not at all hard to make, it is super easy to make and taste simply amazing.

 

Pepper Chicken Gravy Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 grams

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Bay Leaf - 1

Onion - 2 large sliced thinly

Green Chilli - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Tomatoes - 2 large chopped finely

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli powder - 2 teaspoons

Garam Masala Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Coriander Leaves for garnishing

 

FOR ROASTING & GRINDING:

Oil - 1 tsp

Fennel Seeds / Saunf / Sombu - 1 tablespoon

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Black Pepper - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Seeds - 2 tablespoons

Onion - 1 large chopped

 

Instructions

Pressure cook chicken with a little salt for 2 to 3 whistles. Set aside.

Heat little oil in a pot. Add in spices and toast them. Take it in a blender.

Add onions and cook till golden brown. Add it with the spices and grind till smooth. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pot, add in onions, chilies and bay leaf. Cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and cook till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add in the ground masala and mix well.

Add salt, turmeric powder, chili powder, and garam masala and cook till oil separates.

Now add in the chicken along with any cooking liquid.

Mix well and simmer till oil separates.

Add coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken Nuggets ( Kids Special ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी चीज चिकन नगेट्स (किड्स स्पेशल) रेसिपी
related.content:
Cheesy chicken nuggets will be your kid's new favorite snack. So delicious and these are pan-fried instead of deep frying so it is more healthy.

This is so easy to make, you can make a bunch of these and freeze them. So you can fry them whenever you need them. Many of my readers have been asking for toddler nuggets recipe. I made this for my little one and she loved it to the core.

 

Cheesy Chicken Nuggets Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Snacks

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken Breast - 2 cut into strips

Oil for pan-frying

 

FOR CRISPY COATING:

Breadcrumbs - 1 cup

Cheese - ¼ cup grated

Dried Parsley - 1 teaspoon

Garlic Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

FOR BATTER:

Cornflour - 2 tablespoons

All-Purpose Flour - 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients for crispy coating and set aside.

Take all ingredients for batter and mix well.

Take the chicken and dip in the batter, coat in breadcrumbs.

Now pan fry till golden brown on each side.

Serve with ketchup.
